title: What you are, not what you have
idea: Schopenhauer ranked what a person is, meaning health, mind, and character, above what they own or how others see them. Only the first goes everywhere with you.
apply: Spend your next free hour on something that builds you, like sleep, exercise, or learning, instead of something you can buy.
remind: Invest in who you are, not only in what you own.
who: Dana, who thinks happiness is the next upgrade.

scenes.nar: Dana believes happiness is a bigger apartment, a senior title, and a nicer car.
Each win feels great for a few weeks, then the feeling fades, and she wants the next thing.
Schopenhauer argued that what you are matters more than what you have. Health, a good mind, and good character go with you everywhere.

items.x: Reads for an hour each night
Keeps the old car another year

scenes.nar: Dana invests in herself. Morning walks, better sleep, an hour of reading. Her mood stops depending on the next purchase.
